features: All original causal slots, with a new constant slot; token-indexed blocks aligned relative to the visible query. Restore the full query-indexed joint tensor. Shared vertices are optional, not a restriction. Values and output classes are not recoded.
optimizer: Store and replace each consumed prefix gradient. Compute both an unrestricted query-wise oracle and a globally shared candidate; prefer sharing only if its cost is no larger. Use integer joint vertex counts and eta=2/(updates+1). Full-batch refreshes all prefixes. Report fresh unrestricted full-training CE/gap and shared update count. No general stale-gradient convergence claim.
forward_only: Retain both global and query-wise consistency records. Use global sharing when consistent, otherwise the unrestricted per-query solution. One epoch, checked against complete-data fitting. Explicit failure if any query has no consistent key.
stop: First observed primary exact accuracy >=99%, or configured update cap; full-batch also stops at a fresh empirical FW gap <=1e-8. Forward-only completes one epoch. All results, failures and diagnostic caps remain visible.
interpretation: All 35 tasks, three arms, two scales, seed zero: 210 diagnostic cells frozen before the adaptive cohort. Original splits and exact metrics remain unchanged. Caps differ from the original full-budget benchmark. No new transformer run or task-specific arithmetic features. Keep all failures and optimization gaps; flat spectrum remains a capacity bound.
